Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. We'd love to run a compact full interview loop for the Backend Engineer role. We want to be respectful of your schedule in NY (ET), so proposing a timezone-bundled plan: two partial-day slots on consecutive days rather than one long day. That reduces long gaps for you and lets us group interviewers into two bundled blocks.

Option A (preferred):
- Day 1 (Tue 17 Nov): 11:00–14:00 ET — pairing + system design (2 blocks), light take-home discussion
- Day 2 (Wed 18 Nov): 10:00–13:00 ET — product + behavioral + debrief with hiring manager

Option B (alternate):
- Single compact day: 10:30–16:00 ET with a 45 min lunch break (we try to avoid).

Can you confirm whether the two-day split works? If yes, please share any hard conflicts (morning/afternoon) and whether you prefer earlier or later in the ET day. I’ve attached your resume we pulled from your application for reference.

Attachments: alex_vega_resume.pdf

Thanks —
Naomi
